AppFailBack.description_en: Fails back a disaster recovery application to the primary zone
AppFailBack.description_zh: 将容灾集切回至主可用区

AppFailOver.description_en: Switches a disaster recovery set to a supported zone
AppFailOver.description_zh: 将容灾集切换至支持的可用区

ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: This operation transfers an application or template created in CADT to another resource group
ChangeResourceGroup.description_zh: 该接口可以将CADT创建的应用或模板从一个资源组转移到另一个资源组

CreateApplication.description_en: This operation creates an application in CADT from an official or a private template. Before calling this operation, ensure that you understand the billing methods and pricing for the associated Alibaba Cloud products
CreateApplication.description_zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解阿里云产品的收费方式和价格。基于CADT上官方模板或私有模板创建新的应用

ExecuteOperationASync.description_en: Performs asynchronous operations on a service
ExecuteOperationASync.description_zh: 异步执行产品操作功能

ExecuteOperationSync.description_en: Executes an operation synchronously to manage resources in an application
ExecuteOperationSync.description_zh: 维护应用下资源API（同步操作）

GetApplication.description_en: Retrieves the basic information, validation results, billing results, and deployment results of a specified application
GetApplication.description_zh: 获取指定应用的基本信息、校验结果、计费结果、部署结果

GetApplicationVariables.description_en: Retrieves the values of all input template variables for an application
GetApplicationVariables.description_zh: 获取一个应用的所有输入的模版变量的值

GetApplicationVariables4Fail.description_en: Retrieves a list of variables that need to be reconfigured
GetApplicationVariables4Fail.description_zh: 获取需要重新配置的变量列表

GetExecuteOperationResult.description_en: Obtains the result of an asynchronous operation

GetFoTaskStatus.description_en: Queries the status of a disaster recovery switchover task by task ID
GetFoTaskStatus.description_zh: 获取指定容灾任务（TaskId）的状态

GetLinkageAttributesTemplate.description_en: Retrieves the optional values for template variables

GetOperationParams.description_en: Retrieves the input parameters for a specific operation
GetOperationParams.description_zh: 查看某操作的输入参数

GetPotentialFailZones.description_en: Queries the zones to which a disaster recovery service can fail over
GetPotentialFailZones.description_zh: 获取指定容灾服务可切换的可用区列表

GetResource4ModifyRecord.description_en: Retrieves the upgrade or downgrade records for an application
GetResource4ModifyRecord.description_zh: 获取询价应用变配记录

GetResult4QueryInstancePrice4Modify.description_en: Retrieves the result of a price inquiry

GetTemplate.description_en: Retrieves information about the template image and architecture diagram
GetTemplate.description_zh: 获取模板图片及架构图相关信息

GetToken.description_en: Obtains temporary authorization to read an architecture diagram, which is valid for 30 minutes
GetToken.description_zh: 获取读取架构图的临时授权，有效期30分钟

InitAppFailOver.description_en: Prepares for an application switchover and initializes the switchover task
InitAppFailOver.description_zh: 应用容灾切换准备，初始化容灾切换任务

ListApplication.description_en: This operation returns a list of all applications that belong to the current user. You can use the optional `keyword` parameter to filter the applications by name
ListApplication.description_zh: 该接口提供当前用户下所有应用的列表。其中可选参数keyword定义应用名中包含的关键字

ListFoCreatedApps.description_en: This operation queries all disaster recovery service plans in the current account
ListFoCreatedApps.description_zh: 接口查询当前账户下所有容灾服务计划

ListOperations.description_en: Lists the operations that a service supports
ListOperations.description_zh: 查看某服务支持的操作

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags of an application or a template
ListTagResources.description_zh: 该接口用于查询应用或模板的标签

ListTemplate.description_en: Retrieves a list of templates, including their names, architecture diagram URLs, and serialized architecture diagram file URLs
ListTemplate.description_zh: 获取模板列表，包括模板名称、架构图地址、架构图序列化文件地址等

ModifyApplicationSpec.description_en: Modifies the configuration of an application

QueryInstancePrice4Modify.description_en: Queries the price for an upgrade or downgrade

QueryInstanceSpec4Modify.description_en: Queries a list of specifications for an upgrade or downgrade

ReConfigApplication.description_en: You can retrieve a list of template variables that need to be reconfigured. After you reassign values to these variables, call this function. The application status changes to `Modifying`, and the properties of failed nodes are updated with the new variable values. For example, you can change the instance type of a failed resource. After the function is executed, you can redeploy the application
ReConfigApplication.description_zh: 用户可以从上面函数获取到需要重新配置的模版变量列表。然后对这些变量重新赋值后，调用本函数，应用状态会变为“修改中”，同时失败节点的属性值会根据传入的模版变量值重新赋值（例如：修改了失败资源的实例类型等）。执行该函数后，用户可以重新部署该应用

ReleaseApplication.description_en: Releases the resources of an application
ReleaseApplication.description_zh: 该接口释放应用的资源

ValidateApplication.description_en: Validates the input for resources in an application. This is an asynchronous operation. You can call GetApplication to retrieve the validation result
ValidateApplication.description_zh: 对应用下的资源输入的合法性进行校验，异步执行，校验结果调用GetApplication获取

ValuateApplication.description_en: Obtains a price quote for the resources in an application. Call GetApplication to retrieve the price quote
ValuateApplication.description_zh: 对应用下的资源进行询价，通过GetApplication获取询价结果

ValuateTemplate.description_en: Retrieves the price of a template
